enlarged_three_qutrit_control.construction: Order8 Sp4 block plus independent order3 transvection Sp2 block; direct-sum symplectic space dimension6. The8block fourth power is -I4, not a scalar on the full6space, so projectivizing retains24.
enlarged_three_qutrit_control.scope: Explicit Z24 subgroup in Sp6(3) and PSp6(3), corresponding to three-qutrit symplectic labels. Does not identify a24-partner regular fermion representation or a protected physical action. This deliberately enlarges the original W33 label space.
